repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

main.description: Writes a dev.knotless.hide record naming it in the account logged in to this appview's web pages, which must own the repository, as `knotless mod hide` does; or, with hidden false, deletes those there are, as `knotless unhide` does. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

description: Hides a pull, an issue or a comment from a repository, or shows it again, as the repository's owner, logged in to this appview's pages.
